summary_en: Oriental Consultants Holdings executed a block repurchase of up to 30,000 shares (0.24% of outstanding shares) at the closing price of 2,985 yen on November 13, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on November 16, for a maximum outlay of 89.55 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Oriental Consultants Holdings resolved by board decision to execute a block repurchase of treasury shares. The company committed to purchase up to 30,000 shares of its own common stock via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on November 16, 2026, at the closing price of 2,985 yen recorded on November 13. The maximum aggregate purchase amount is 89.55 million yen, representing 0.24 percent of outstanding shares (12,359,740 shares excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026).

The purchase order will be placed during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading window and is valid for that session only. Market conditions may result in partial or no execution of the full order. The company stated that the repurchase is intended to enable shareholder returns and to maintain flexibility in capital allocation in response to changing business conditions.
